messages:
maia: @here Quick FYI — rolling out Private v2.1.3 next Wed (2026-04-01) to Wave-3 customers. Main items: updated BYO-network compatibility matrix (MTU/firewall rules), a new export-control checklist required for regulated customers, and KMS attestation flow that now supports external HSM rotation. Link: https://go/internal/private-v2-1-3-release-notes (internal). Please validate preflight and confirm readiness by Tue EOD. If you're owning a Wave-3 customer, drop :white_check_mark: on this thread when done.
jordan: Thanks — what's the upgrade window and rollback plan?
maia: Maintenance window is 02:00-05:00 UTC. Rollback uses snapshot + quick-swap; see runbook. Preflight command (example):
```
docker pull redwood/private-agent:2.1.3
docker run --rm -v /var/lib/redwood:/data redwood/private-agent:2.1.3 preflight --customer-id=CUST123 --check-kms
```
If preflight fails, follow the "hold and escalate" steps in the runbook.
opsbot: deploy-scheduler: Scheduled rollout created for wave-3: start=3342150000 window=10800s owner=@maia id=rollout-33421 :gear:
sam (security): Important note — the new export-control checklist requires customers to sign an EULA addendum before we flip the feature. Legal clearance required. I will DM the template to @lindsey and @anil and drop it in the shared drive.
lindsey (support): Got it. We'll add a column to the readiness sheet and ping customers tomorrow morning.
anil (sales): Thanks — ping me the list of customers who need the addendum so contracts can route. Any pricing delta for compliance?
maia: No pricing change for the addendum. For BYO-network, we've tightened allowed MTU ranges — older appliances might need a patch. @devon can you add a quick diagnostic to the runbook?
devon (eng-runtime): Yep. I'll add a 1-liner diag and a short note about KV-cache changes. Example diagnostic:
```
# check mtu & basic firewall rules
ip link show dev eth0 | grep mtu && sudo iptables -L -n | head -n 10
```
Also flag: KV-cache eviction behavior was tuned for hosted/private parity — should be transparent, but please monitor tail latency for the first 24h after rollout.
maia: Action items summary: Support - add addendum status column (@lindsey); Sales - collect customers needing addenda (@anil); Security - attach signed template in drive (@sam); Eng - add diag script + create monitor alert (@devon). React with :white_check_mark: when your piece is done. We'll hold final GA if any blockers remain by Tue 23:59 UTC. Thanks!
